name: hf_3d_arena
title: 3D Arena: image-to-3D outputs of 29 generators on 100 shared input images
description: The benchmark behind the 3D Arena Space: for each of ~100 input images (inputs/images, from the iso3D dataset) the output of 29 image-to-3D models under outputs/<model>/<image>.glb|.ply with a rendered preview .png. Meshes are glTF (Y-up, metres by spec, scale is the generator's own); the .ply outputs of the Gaussian-splat generators (SAM-3D-Objects-3DGS) are splats. A sample is one (model, image) pair.

license.note: MIT on the Hub card (checked 2026-10-13). Outputs are generated by third-party models from iso3D input images; the input images' and each generator's terms are not stated here, TO CONFIRM before any use beyond evaluation.

citation: Ebert D. 3D Arena: An Open Platform for Generative 3D Evaluation. arXiv:2506.18787, 2025.

mesh.description: Generated glTF mesh (Y-up, metres by the glTF specification; absolute scale is arbitrary)

splat.description: Generated PLY: Gaussian splats for the 3DGS generators (SAM-3D-Objects-3DGS); check the model folder for others
